The ruby-topaz hummingbird is a species of hummingbird which lives in Nort-East and Centre-East South America. It is 8 to 9.5 cm long and weighs 2.5 to 5 g. It inhabits the interior and edges of open savanna-like landscapes and shrubby arid hillsides where it feeds on nectar from a wide variety of flowering shrubs, trees, epiphytes, cacti, and crops.

name: Ear Bone of a Whale
description: The ear bone of a whale, known as the tympanic bulla, is one of the most distinctive and valuable parts of its skeleton for scientific study. Unlike in many other mammals, whale ear bones are extremely dense and isolated from the skull, allowing them to detect underwater sound with incredible sensitivity. These adaptations are crucial for communication, navigation, and hunting in the deep ocean. Fossilized whale ear bones also help researchers identify species and understand whale evolution due to their unique shapes and durability.

name: ABYSSINIAN ROLLER
description:
Abyssinian Roller adalah burung berukuran sedang dengan panjang tubuh mencapai 28–30 cm, ditambah bulu ekor tengah yang memanjang hingga total sekitar 37 cm pada individu dewasa. Tubuh bagian atas didominasi warna biru kehijauan cerah dengan punggung cokelat kayu manis yang kontras jelas dengan warna kepala dan sayap. Bagian bawah tubuh, termasuk dada dan perut, berwarna biru muda lembut, sementara sayapnya menunjukkan gradasi biru tua kehitaman dan hijau zamrud.

Kepalanya relatif besar dan bulat, disertai paruh kuat berwarna hitam yang lurus dan cukup tebal, ideal untuk menangkap serangga besar seperti kumbang dan belalang. Mata berwarna gelap dengan lingkar mata tipis berwarna kusam, memberikan ekspresi tajam namun tenang.

Bulu ekornya menonjol, terdiri dari dua helai bulu tengah yang sangat memanjang dan berujung runcing, tampak mencolok baik saat terbang maupun bertengger. Kakinya berukui ke belakang, tiga ke depan), memungkinkan cengkeraman kuat pada dahan ketika menunggu mangsa lewat.

name: Charcoal Black Dark Dragon
description:
A massive charcoal-black dark dragon with a long, sinewy body covered in rough, volcanic scales.
Glowing red, vein-like markings pulse faintly across its sides and wings, giving the creature a molten, almost living-lava appearance.

Its head is sharp and predatory — shaped like a mix of bird of prey and ancient wyrm, with jagged teeth and deep-set, undead-looking eyes. Two long, ivory horns sweep backward from the skull, while smaller spikes and ridges run along the neck and spine, enhancing its aggressive silhouette.

The enormous wings stretch out like torn leather sails, heavily creased and reinforced by dark bone structures underneath. The membranes look weathered and scarred, as if the dragon has survived countless battles.

The overall pose is coiled and threatening — wings partially unfurled, head lowered, ready to strike with ancient intelligence and lethal intent.

A deadly, volcanic, battle-scarred dragon — alive, aware, and terrifying.
